exposure: HALP score (hemoglobin, albumin, lymphocyte, and platelet score)
outcome: neonatal outcomes (including lower birthweight and reduced Apgar scores)
cohort: 100 patients with histopathologically confirmed placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who underwent cesarean hysterectomy between 2016 and 2025.
finding: Higher HALP scores were paradoxically associated with increased maternal morbidity and adverse neonatal outcomes, including lower birthweight, reduced Apgar scores, and earlier gestational age at diagnosis, in patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS).
